audio_preparation: Demucs htdemucs --two-stems=vocals, CPU; all aligners below received separated vocals. Original mix was retained only as the request original-audio reference for app scoring.
anchor_policy: No faster-whisper. Qwen ASR disabled. SOFA and Tune Studio had no ASR timing anchors and used lyric-order interpolation for bounded windows. WhisperX CTC aligned supplied chart lyrics directly.

not_scored.SOFA-combined: English-only in this setup; Polish unsupported.
not_scored.ForceAlign: English-only in this adapter; Polish unsupported.
not_scored.Qwen3-ASR / Qwen3-ForcedAligner: Not rerun; this machine has no CUDA or MPS accelerator and CPU model inference was not attempted.
not_scored.IPA-native singing aligner: No usable local checkpoint/inference adapter in the project.

caveats: Tune Studio Polish output uses Uroman transliteration into an English/German model vocabulary; treat it as exploratory.
SOFA and Tune Studio results here are from a no-ASR-anchor configuration, not the earlier faster-whisper-anchored runs.
Scores compare the supplied audio versions with the supplied UltraStar charts; audio/chart version mismatch may contribute to timing error.
